body:
Operator, 2026-08-30 (verbatim intent): CWNG should be a 'device hub' — a home for KOReader
devices and standard Kobo devices — and setting up a family member's device + personal library
should be 'super easy' and fully walkable in the UI. Tonight's measured gap: pairing a Kobo still
requires the CLASSIC account page (generate sync URL) plus hand-editing api_endpoint in the
device's Kobo eReader.conf; the SPA Devices page literally says 'Manage your Kobo sync URL in the
classic account page' (frontend/src/pages/Devices.tsx:217). A first-class SPA pairing flow —
per-user sync URL generation with copy button, step-by-step device instructions (Kobo conf edit /
KOReader sync settings), and confirmation when the device first checks in — closes the loop.
Related in-flight context: household walkthrough at
https://projects.159trunk-h3q57.tv/pages/cwng-family-library-setup/ and CORPUS.md item 25b.
title: Device hub: SPA-native Kobo/KOReader pairing flow (sync URL setup still classic-only)
